name: Atakpamé

queries.query: Atakpamé Togo official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastre land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the OTR Direction du Cadastre, de la Conservation Foncière et de l’Enregistrement (DCCFE), an official Géodata Togo portal, and an official OTR notice establishing a Numéro Unique Parcellaire (NUP). No Atakpamé-specific public parcel vector service was identified in the returned first-party results.

queries.query: Atakpamé Togo cadastre parcelles carte officielle registre foncier
queries.result: La recherche officielle a identifié la DCCFE de l’OTR, sa Division Régionale Atakpamé, le Géoportail national et des avis officiels concernant les opérations foncières à Atakpamé. Aucun service vectoriel public propre à Atakpamé ni réponse anonyme sûre avec identifiant parcellaire et géométrie n’a été trouvé.

registryEvidence.custodian: Office Togolais des Recettes (OTR), Direction du Cadastre, de la Conservation Foncière et de l’Enregistrement (DCCFE).
registryEvidence.scope: The official DCCFE mission page describes the cadastre as the national technical, fiscal and legal land archive, and the official contacts page lists a Division Régionale Atakpamé.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: A national custodian and an Atakpamé regional division are evidenced, but no public Atakpamé parcel map, local registry procedure, or anonymous parcel feature response was independently qualified; registryFound remains null.

parcelDiscovery.source: Official Géodata Togo open-data portal and OTR/DCCFE sources
parcelDiscovery.note: The public Géodata configuration was inspected; no open-data layer tagged with the Cadastre theme or named for parcels/land registry was returned. No usable bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. Exact-point coverage is unknown and is not treated as citywide absence.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 via first-party discovery; official contacts page lists Division Régionale Atakpamé and national DCCFE divisions. No parcel geometry endpoint exposed.
Official DCCFE mission page returned in first-party discovery; confirms national cadastral mandate and describes cadastral parcel records. No public feature service exposed.

HTTP 200; official portal shell returned. Current JavaScript/configuration was inspected and identified https://api.geodata.gouv.tg/ as the open-data API and https://geoserver.geoportail.gouv.tg/ as the GeoServer base.
HTTP 200 JSON; public configuration returned themes including Cadastre, but the returned open-data couches array contained no layer tagged with theme 16 and no parcel/cadastral layer was exposed.
HTTP 200 JSON; administrative region/prefecture/commune geometry endpoint returned public boundary data, not parcel data. No parcel identity or parcel geometry was requested or retained.
HTTP 401 Unauthorized; no credentials were used and no bypass was attempted. This is an access limitation, not evidence of absent Atakpamé parcels.
Official DCCFE integrated-management landing page identified by first-party discovery. No anonymous parcel geometry or safe public feature schema was obtained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No usable parcel feature response obtained; zero is not an absence finding.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No usable parcel response; exact WUP point [7.52399072023767, 1.13784949472366] preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved; no coordinate shift was made.

This packet is research only, not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: OTR/DCCFE and its Atakpamé regional division are clearly evidenced, and Togo’s public Géodata portal is reachable. However, the current open-data configuration exposes no parcel layer, the GeoServer capabilities route requires authentication, and parcel coverage, schema, native identity semantics, CRS, update behavior, and anonymous access remain unresolved.
